svg.aria-label: The plan mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake agent: 3 questions, you confirm (stop); Socratic mentor, chapter by chapter (agent); Structure architect: the outline (agent); Socratic mentor and argument builder: the stress test (agent); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent) | paper: Intake: you confirm (stop); Socratic mentor: started once, resumed with each answer (agent); The mentor's question: each answer; offers after 8 rounds on a chapter and 30 in all (stop); Planner: the outline from the chapter summaries (agent); Mentor, Step 2.5: contribution sharpening, one round or more (agent); Planner: evaluates each stress-test answer (agent); Planner: the chapter plan (agent); The plan's handoff (stop).

svg.text: academic-paper marks no stop in the dialogue rounds. Scripts and the session's own steps are left out. Not drawn because they are the same in every mode of paper: at every agent start, a model other than the configured one stops the run (D47);

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at every patch, a structural patch, a patch that does not apply or a failed script stops it (a ruling of plan 5).
